zones.name: West Canyon Insertion
zones.description: Rocky western canyon ridge with Player Start at [60.0, 200.0] overlooking the staging base, flanked by desert boulders and Tripwire Alarms M08_T1_01 ([265.0, 185.0]) and M08_T1_02 ([280.0, 120.0]).

zones.name: Staging Motor Pool & Target Cargo Truck
zones.description: Adobe-walled motor pool (env_wall_adobe_4m) with guard booth (env_guard_booth_a), fuel tanks, Alarm Panel M08_ALM_01, and the Driveable Objective Cargo Truck (veh_truck_cargo_a, 500 Max HP) parked at [390.0, 130.0] (O1 Phase 1).

zones.name: Western Highway Stretch
zones.description: 700m desert asphalt highway flanked by rocky ambush ridges, patrolled by E13 mobile jeep crews and guarded by off-road Buried Mines M08_T4_01 ([820.0, 135.0]) and M08_T4_02 ([1050.0, 165.0]).

zones.name: Checkpoint Alpha
zones.description: Fortified roadblock across x=1250.0 with motorized steel barrier gate, Watchtower (env_watchtower_metal_a) with Sniper M08_E6_01, Heavy Gunner M08_E5_01, Panning Camera M08_CAM_01, Directional Mine M08_T3_01, Automated Sentry Turret M08_T9_01 ([1245.0, 175.0]), and Roadside Control Box #1 at [1185.0, 115.0] (S1 part 1).

zones.name: Eastern Canyon Highway & Sandstorm Sector
zones.description: 700m canyon road where the dynamic Sandstorm event (E_M08_STORM) hits, cutting enemy vision to 0.5x for 120s.

zones.name: Checkpoint Bravo
zones.description: Second heavily fortified barrier at x=2050.0 guarded by Sniper M08_E6_02, Heavy Gunner M08_E5_02, Elite Squad E4, Camera M08_CAM_02, Directional Mine M08_T3_02, Sentry Turret M08_T9_02 ([2045.0, 125.0]), and Roadside Control Box #2 at [1980.0, 185.0] (S1 part 2).

zones.name: East Delivery Depot & Extraction
zones.description: Final delivery warehouse and Extraction Zone at [2400.0, 170.0] (radius: 10.0m) where the Cargo Truck must be parked intact.

primary.title: Hijack cargo truck at (390, 130), pass Checkpoints Alpha & Bravo, and deliver it to (2400, 170)

secondary.title: Hack both checkpoint barriers from the roadside control boxes before driving through
Deliver the cargo truck with above 300 HP remaining (Ghost Medal)

extraction.title: Park Cargo Truck intact at East Delivery Depot Extraction (2400, 170)

events.description: Upon entering Zone E (or elapsed >= 720s), a heavy desert sandstorm rolls in, reducing enemy sightlines to 50% for 120s.
If alert_level == 3 for 30s while driving the truck, spawn 2 pursuit jeeps (veh_jeep_tactical_a with E13 gunners) at [300.0, 150.0].

silent.name: Silent Route (Stealth Hijack, Dismount Barrier Bypass & Sandstorm Run > 300 HP)
silent.description: Infiltrate Zone B from [60, 200] -> silently hijack Cargo Truck at [390, 130] -> dismount before Checkpoint Alpha at [1210, 148] to lower barrier -> drive through Zone E Sandstorm at [1650, 150] -> dismount before Checkpoint Bravo at [2010, 150] -> deliver intact (>300 HP) to [2400, 170].

technical.name: Technical Route (Roadside Control Box PDA Hacks [1185, 115] & [1980, 185] + EMP Turrets)
technical.description: Advance from [60, 200] -> hijack Cargo Truck at [390, 130] -> hack Roadside Control Box #1 at [1185, 115] (raising Barrier #1 & disabling T9_01) -> drive through opened Checkpoint Alpha at [1250, 150] -> hack Roadside Control Box #2 at [1980, 185] (opening Barrier #2 & disabling T9_02) -> park at [2400, 170].

loud.name: Loud Route (Counter-Snipe Towers, C4 Turrets & Roadblock Breach vs Chase Jeeps)
loud.description: Push from [60, 200] into Zone B -> commandeer Cargo Truck at [390, 130] -> snipe E6_01 & C4 T9_01 to breach Checkpoint Alpha at [1250, 150] -> fend off E_M08_CHASE jeeps along [1700, 150] -> breach Checkpoint Bravo at [2050, 150] -> reach extraction at [2400, 170].
